US elections have never been just about American voters. The people who cast their votes may be Americans, but the consequences of their choices are often felt across the world. And this time, the world seems to be watching with even greater interest. Driven by escalating wars, shifting global alliances, and growing cultural divisions, American politics now serves as a critical barometer—not only for the nation’s internal future but also for the trajectory of the wider world.
